settings.network.title: Network permissions
settings.network.description: Manage network permissions for analysis and local MCP. Revoking access closes connections; running kernels keep their variables.
settings.network.scope: Public hostnames permit TCP tunnels on port 443 after TLS ClientHello inspection. Private IPv4 addresses also allow HTTP on the specified port (default 443), e.g. 192.168.1.10:8080. Tunnels can carry raw TCP; the proxy does not verify a TLS handshake. No scheme, path or wildcard. Block rules take precedence.
